name: 122. OpenAI Responses drops foreign function_call item id (foreign-function-call-id)
description: Gemini's streaming Responses converter packs the thought signature into the tool call id (<id>_ts_<sig>) and reuses that string as the function_call item id, not only call_id. OpenAI requires an input function_call item id to begin with fc, so replaying that history to /v1/responses natively or through a gemini -> openai fallback 400s with input[N].id. Fix: ToOpenAIResponsesRequest drops a function_call item id that does not begin with fc and leaves call_id untouched so the function_call_output still pairs with its call. Case 1 pins the native route; case 2 drives the real fallback (invalid gemini primary model, openai fallback) so the shared input crosses the OpenAI seam the way the report described.

item.name: openai/gpt-4o-mini native /v1/responses: Gemini _ts_ function_call item id dropped, call_id kept - foreign-function-call-id

exec: pm.test('No input[N].id rejection for a foreign function_call item id - foreign-function-call-id', function () {
var body = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.expect(body, 'OpenAI rejected the replayed function_call item id (must begin with fc): ' + body).to.not.match(/input\[\d+\]\.id/);
pm.expect(body.toLowerCase(), 'OpenAI rejected the replayed function_call item id: ' + body).to.not.include('begin with');
pm.expect(body.toLowerCase(), 'OpenAI rejected the replayed function_call item id: ' + body).to.not.include('start with');
pm.test('Replay with Gemini _ts_ function_call item id succeeds - foreign-function-call-id', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'responses replay request failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.below(400);
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.expect(j.output, 'expected an output array').to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;

body.raw: {"model":"openai/gpt-4o-mini","input":[{"type":"message","role":"user","content":"What is the weather in San Francisco? Answer in one short sentence."},{"type":"function_call","id":"call_replay_ts_QUJDREVG","call_id":"call_replay_ts_QUJDREVG","status":"completed","name":"get_weather","arguments":"{\"city\": \"San Francisco\"}"},{"type":"function_call_output","call_id":"call_replay_ts_QUJDREVG","output":"{\"temperature\": \"22\", \"unit\": \"celsius\"}"}],"max_output_tokens":200}

item.name: gemini -> openai/gpt-4o-mini fallback /v1/responses: replayed _ts_ function_call item id dropped at the OpenAI seam - foreign-function-call-id

exec: pm.test('No input[N].id rejection for a foreign function_call item id - foreign-function-call-id fallback', function () {
var body = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.expect(body, 'OpenAI rejected the replayed function_call item id (must begin with fc): ' + body).to.not.match(/input\[\d+\]\.id/);
pm.expect(body.toLowerCase(), 'OpenAI rejected the replayed function_call item id: ' + body).to.not.include('begin with');
pm.expect(body.toLowerCase(), 'OpenAI rejected the replayed function_call item id: ' + body).to.not.include('start with');
pm.test('Replay with Gemini _ts_ function_call item id succeeds - foreign-function-call-id fallback', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'responses replay request failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.below(400);
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.expect(j.output, 'expected an output array').to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;
pm.test('The openai fallback actually served the request - foreign-function-call-id fallback', function () {
var j = pm.response.json();
var ef = j.extra_fields || {};
var ri = ef.routing_info || {};
pm.expect(ri.is_fallback, 'gemini primary did not fall back, so the replay never crossed the OpenAI seam: ' + JSON.stringify(ef)).to.eql(true);
pm.expect(ri.provider || ef.provider, 'fallback served by an unexpected provider: ' + JSON.stringify(ef)).to.eql('openai');
